themes.title: Debates Intensify Over Far-Right Normalization and Executive Power
themes.blurb: Media coverage and commentators across borders are highlighting the continued mainstreaming of far-right political forces alongside growing scrutiny of unilateral executive power. In both Sweden and the United States, debates focus on the political dominance of populist movements and the expanding use of executive authority.

themes.blurb: Right-wing figures and political parties in multiple nations continue to accuse mainstream media and digital platforms of suppression and bias. Representatives frame local moderation decisions and national broadcasting clashes as direct threats to democratic dialogue.
